$comment: Backlog del arnés. Fuente de verdad de QUÉ hay que hacer. El orden no es decorativo: las dos primeras features fijan el rumbo (qué se quiere resolver → cómo se va a resolver) antes de que nadie escriba código. Los agentes leen la primera feature pendiente, la marcan in_progress y no la marcan done hasta que ./init.sh pasa en verde. Tras cerrar (harness finish), el líder propone el commit del cierre con git commit_feature --dry-run y espera confirmación del usuario. Estados válidos: pending | in_progress | done | blocked. Este backlog es el de arranque de un proyecto nuevo: sustitúyelo por el tuyo con 'harness add'.

Lo único que falta es sustituir <IP> por la IP/URL real del servidor, poner GEAS_TOKEN en .env y ejecutar el setup. Tap a point: scene, real photo one tap away, schedule today+next days and on-now, story card, walk directions + add-to-route, nearest car park with occupancy and update time, confirmation status and last_verified date.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. Panel opens on tap
  2. Scene and real photo both available
  3. Schedule and on-now state shown
  4. Story card shown
  5. Walk directions and add-to-route button
  6. Nearest car park occupancy + update time
  7. Confirmation status and last_verified shown
acceptance_criteria: Scene and real photo both available
Nearest car park occupancy + update time

features.title: Story cards for Christmas points
features.description:
3-5 sentence story per point about the tradition. Set of cards tells the history of Christmas in Vigo. Every historical claim has a source link; unsourced cards not shown.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. Card per shown point
  2. 3-5 sentences each
  3. Every historical claim sourced
  4. Cards read in order tell Vigo Christmas history
  5. Unsourced cards hidden
acceptance_criteria: Cards read in order tell Vigo Christmas history

features.title: Events UI (list + map layer)
features.description:
Daily events list and map layer, date picker for next days, filters (date, time of day, category, free, near me), permanent items and cycles grouped, add-to-route.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. Events list and map layer
  2. Date picker for future days
  3. Filters work
  4. Permanent/cycle items grouped
  5. Add-to-route button
  6. Events without clock time show 'time to be confirmed'
acceptance_criteria: Events without clock time show 'time to be confirmed'

features.title: Route planner (walking, 3 options)
features.description:
Input start + time window + chosen stops. Output 3 options (fastest, after dark, easy walk) with total time, distance, ordered stops and plain explanation. Events as time windows. Pedestrian graph from OSM. Exact search up to ~12 stops. Missing stop reported, not silently skipped.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. 3 options returned for same input
  2. Deterministic order (weather/parking hints only change summary text)
  3. Event pinned at 20:00 -> no option arrives after 20:00
  4. Unreachable stop reported with drop suggestion
  5. Answers in under 2s for 12 stops
  6. Walking times from OSM pedestrian graph
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic order (weather/parking hints only change summary text)
Event pinned at 20:00 -> no option arrives after 20:00
Unreachable stop reported with drop suggestion
Walking times from OSM pedestrian graph

features.title: Postcard pipeline and UI
features.description:
Upload/take photo, pick place, optional message+name -> pixel-art postcard. Vision model describes photo as structured data (no identification). Image model draws person in scene. Frame/title/name/message added in code. PNG download + share. Credit line + date. Daily per-device limit and monthly spending cap. Photo and result not kept unless user opts in. Notice about third-party model.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. Photo upload/capture works on mobile
  2. Place picker from Christmas points
  3. Vision description is structured, no identification
  4. Person drawn in scene in pixel style
  5. Frame/title/name/message added in code, not by model
  6. PNG download and share
  7. Daily per-device limit enforced
  8. Monthly spending cap enforced
  9. No server-side retention unless opted in
  10. Notice about third-party model shown
acceptance_criteria: Vision description is structured, no identification
Person drawn in scene in pixel style
Frame/title/name/message added in code, not by model
No server-side retention unless opted in

features.title: Galician/Spanish/English strings
features.description:
All UI strings externalised; no hard-coded text.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. Strings in gl/es/en
  2. No hard-coded user-facing strings
  3. Language switch works

features.title: Vitrasa GTFS ingest
features.description:
Stops, lines, timetables; 'scheduled' labelling; cross-check with Christmas mobility plan (cancelled stops).

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. GTFS ingested (stops, lines, timetables)
  2. Labelled 'scheduled', not live
  3. Cancelled Christmas stops cross-checked
  4. No dependency on unofficial real-time wrappers
acceptance_criteria: No dependency on unofficial real-time wrappers

features.title: Renfe static GTFS ingest
features.description:
Ingest long-distance and Cercanias GTFS; check Vigo stops present.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. Long-distance GTFS ingested
  2. Cercanias GTFS ingested
  3. Vigo-Urzáiz and Vigo-Guixar present
  4. Stops listed

features.title: Renfe live feasibility check
features.description:
Test whether real-time feeds cover Vigo; go/no-go decision.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. Trip-update and vehicle-position endpoints tested for Vigo
  2. Coverage documented
  3. Go/no-go recorded
  4. Protobuf decoding handled or noted as blocker
acceptance_criteria: Trip-update and vehicle-position endpoints tested for Vigo
Protobuf decoding handled or noted as blocker

features.title: Transit legs in planner + next departures
features.description:
Walking+bus transit legs in planner; next departures at nearest stop/station in point panel.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. Transit leg option in planner
  2. Next departures shown in point panel
  3. Bus stop and train station layers on map
acceptance_criteria: Next departures shown in point panel
Bus stop and train station layers on map

features.title: Buildings: 3D footprint + height layer
features.description:
Read FeatureServer in pages, reproject EPSG:25829->WGS84, check GeoJSON for MultiPatch, altura completeness and licence; export offline footprint+height file; fallback Catastro footprints joined by refcat.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. Pagination implemented (<=2000 records/request)
  2. Reprojection to WGS84 correct
  3. GeoJSON MultiPatch feasibility documented
  4. altura completeness measured
  5. Licence recorded
  6. Offline file exported
  7. Fallback documented

features.title: Busy-now estimate prototype
features.description:
Coarse per-zone busy estimate (quiet/normal/busy) from car park occupancy, traffic, agenda, weekday/holiday, weather, Celta matches. Labelled 'estimate', hides if >=2 inputs missing.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. 3 levels per zone
  2. Inputs combined
  3. Word 'estimate' always visible
  4. No person counts shown
  5. Hides itself if >=2 inputs missing
  6. Celta home match dates considered

features.title: MITMA OD analysis for Vigo
features.description:
Typical December flows into the centre from MITMA mobile data to seed busy estimate.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. MITMA CSVs acquired for Vigo
  2. December flows into centre extracted
  3. District granularity documented
  4. Fed into X-06

features.title: Traffic layer
features.description:
Inspect treal.geojson; render segments or fall back to city-wide indicator.

Criterios de aceptación:
  1. treal.geojson inspected and usability documented
  2. Segments rendered if usable, else city-wide indicator
  3. Source freshness shown
acceptance_criteria: Segments rendered if usable, else city-wide indicator

features.title: Cameras via server or links only

Criterios de aceptación:

acceptance_criteria: Either proxied images or links implemented
